infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Allow Kinship to access your contacts to help you add people to your garden.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Allow Kinship to check your calendar so it can gently suggest capturing memories after events with people in your garden.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Allow Kinship to access your photos to attach them to memories in your garden.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow Kinship to use your camera to take photos for your memories.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Kinship to access your photos to attach them to memories in your garden.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Kinship to use your camera to take photos for your memories.

plugins.contactsPermission: Allow Kinship to access your contacts to help you add people to your garden.

plugins.calendarPermission: Allow Kinship to check your calendar so it can gently suggest capturing memories after events with people in your garden.
plugins.remindersPermission: Kinship doesn't read or change your reminders. iOS requires this description because Kinship's calendar support also covers reminders.
